title: sbmlode: ordinary differential equations of SBML models

creators.affiliation: Humboldt-University Berlin, Faculty of Life Science, Institute for Biology, Biology, Berlin; University Lübeck; University Hospital Schleswig-Holstein, Campus Lübeck, First Department of Medicine, Germany
creators.name: König, Matthias

description:
sbmlode writes the system of ordinary differential equations of a model in the Systems Biology Markup Language (SBML) as python, julia and R code which simulates it and as LaTeX, typst and markdown documents which describe it, implemented on top of libsbml with source code available from https://github.com/matthiaskoenig/sbmlode

The code covers the semantics of SBML core, including initial assignments, rules, conversion factors and events, and is verified against roadrunner over the SBML test suite. The documents are used by SBML4Humans to show the equations of a model.

The documentation is available at https://matthiaskoenig.github.io/sbmlode
